row.notes: TeamSelect onEnter (vtable slot +0x40, abs ptr 0x14585a6a0). flow state StateDriverCareerContractNegotiationsTeamSelect (name string 0x14585a5b0, vtable 0x14585a660; the same layout as the Intro vtable 0x14585a470, whose slot +0x40 is Career_ContractIntro_OnEnter): the team select step of the Driver Career contract negotiation, entered after ContractNegotiationsDecision when the player's contract ends (before Intro, Update and Outro); it is absent from the start-of-career flow. It stores the online negotiation controller (component desc 0x146060840) at state+0xd70 and the contracts manager at +0xd78, sets +0xd69 (both present) and +0xd6a (0x140d80860 of the manager), and on its first pass (+0xc9c clear) builds the team select screen, sets +0xc9c = 1 and clears the selection flag +0xc98; returns 1 once entered. Raised by laneS (Progressive Career follow mode skips this screen).
